query:
UPDATE amortization_schedule s
SET s.isPaid = true, s.paidAt = NOW()
WHERE s.loanId IN (SELECT DISTINCT loanId FROM payments)
AND s.periodNumber IN (
  SELECT s2.periodNumber FROM amortization_schedule s2
  INNER JOIN payments p ON s2.loanId = p.loanId
  WHERE s2.loanId = s.loanId
  GROUP BY s2.loanId, s2.periodNumber
);
